hooks.name: Boo proof gate
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs: if it is git commit, git push or git merge, re-run the engine on the samples (the Slotly demo against its hidden truth, and the gym export) and compare with the sealed certificates in certificates/. Blocks with the reason when a certificate is STILL HAUNTED, its seal is broken, or the engine now gives a different result than the committed one. Any other command passes at once. Runs node bin/boo.mjs hook gate, which reads the event's tool_input.command from stdin.
